# QAccelPlot

> QAccelPlot is a 2D plotting library for Qt Quick. Line curves render through
> the Qt Scene Graph with GPU shaders; C++ data paths replace millions of points
> per frame at 60 FPS. Built-in pan, zoom, rescale, and hover hit testing.
> QML components backed by C++. Dual-licensed under GPLv3 with the Universal
> FOSS Exception, or a commercial license.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://michalgrabarczyk.github.io/QAccelPlot/getting-started/): Build your first QAccelPlot application with CMake and QML
- [Concepts and Architecture](https://michalgrabarczyk.github.io/QAccelPlot/concepts/): How Plot, PlotView, Axes, LineCurve, and the Qt Scene Graph fit together
- [Performance Guide](https://michalgrabarczyk.github.io/QAccelPlot/performance/): Data-ingestion paths from QML points to moved C++ float buffers, worker handoff, and benchmarking
- [Cookbook](https://michalgrabarczyk.github.io/QAccelPlot/cookbook/): Recipes for static plots, real-time scrolling data, axis formats, multiple axes, styling, annotations, point clouds, and background data production
- [FAQ](https://michalgrabarczyk.github.io/QAccelPlot/faq/): Frequently asked questions about licensing, performance, threading, and compatibility
- [API Reference](https://michalgrabarczyk.github.io/QAccelPlot/api/): Generated C++ and QML type documentation — properties, methods, signals, and enums
- [Troubleshooting](https://michalgrabarczyk.github.io/QAccelPlot/troubleshooting/): Common setup and runtime issues with solutions

## Code

- [Library Source](https://github.com/michalgrabarczyk/QAccelPlot/tree/main/QAccelPlot/src): C++ library implementation
- [QML Types](https://github.com/michalgrabarczyk/QAccelPlot/tree/main/QAccelPlot/qml): Plot and Legend QML wrappers
- [Examples](https://github.com/michalgrabarczyk/QAccelPlot/tree/main/examples): Complete runnable applications (quickstart, realtime, pulsar_showcase, annotations, axis_formats, custom_axis, interactive_tools, performance_showcase, point_cloud, styling_and_transitions)
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/michalgrabarczyk/QAccelPlot/tree/main/benchmarks): Performance measurement scenarios
